milestones.name: Concept & Pillars
milestones.goal: The fantasy, the pillars and the core loop are written down and agreed by all three of us. We know what game we are making.

milestones.name: Playable Prototype
milestones.goal: The core loop is playable end to end on one level, and a stranger can tell us whether it is fun.

milestones.name: Vertical Slice
milestones.goal: One act at ship quality: art, audio, UX, onboarding and balance. The bar every later act is held to.

milestones.name: Alpha
milestones.goal: Content complete: every act, tower, enemy and progression system is in, even if rough.

milestones.name: Beta
milestones.goal: Balanced, polished and bug-fixed. Only release blockers remain.

epics.name: Vision & Pillars
epics.summary: What the game is, who it is for, and the few things we refuse to compromise on.

epics.name: Core Loop & Pacing
epics.summary: Moment to moment, wave to wave, level to level. Session length, tempo, win and lose.

epics.name: Towers & Upgrades
epics.summary: Tower roles, upgrade paths, branches and champions, targeting.

epics.name: Hero
epics.summary: Whether and how the player is present on the field: abilities, aggro, progression.

epics.name: Enemies & Bosses
epics.summary: Enemy roster, damage types and resistances, elite and boss encounters.

epics.name: Cards & Keywords
epics.summary: Keywords, synergies and the card system. The card engine's future is itself an open question.

epics.name: Economy & Balance
epics.summary: Income, sinks, pacing curve, and the numbers that make it fair.

epics.name: Run Structure & Progression
epics.summary: Acts, levels, unlocks, relics, skill trees and the meta layer.

epics.name: Levels & Encounters
epics.summary: Map design, lanes, gates and key mechanics, encounter variety.

epics.name: Narrative & World
epics.summary: The story that ties the ideas together, characters, tone.

epics.name: Art & Audio
epics.summary: Art direction, assets, music and sound.

epics.name: Tech, Tools & Pipeline
epics.summary: Engine work, tooling, CI and the simulation bot.

epics.name: Playtesting & Research
epics.summary: Reference games, playtest protocol, and what we learn from watching people play.

tickets.title: Decide: does the **card engine** stay, go, or become something else?
tickets.notes: The in-flight RTS loop work (branch feature/ken-rts-loop) strips the card engine: spells become Hero abilities, monster cards become a Barracks tower. Most of Cards & Keywords, and part of Progression, depends on this answer. Settle it before writing more card or reward design.
tickets.criteria:
- [ ] Options written down with what each costs us
- [ ] Playtested both loops back to back
- [ ] Decision recorded here, with the reason

tickets.title: Write the **design pillars** (3 to 5) and the elevator pitch
tickets.notes: A pillar is a sentence we can use to say no. Each one should name something we would cut to protect it.
tickets.criteria:
- [ ] 3 to 5 pillars, one sentence each
- [ ] Each pillar names what we would cut to protect it
- [ ] Elevator pitch in two sentences
- [ ] All three of us agree

tickets.title: Draw the **core loop** on one page: moment, wave, level, run
tickets.notes: One diagram per time scale. Mark where the player makes a meaningful decision, and where they are only waiting.
tickets.criteria:
- [ ] Four time scales drawn: moment, wave, level, run
- [ ] Every decision point marked
- [ ] Every waiting point marked
- [ ] Reviewed by all three of us

tickets.title: Define the **player fantasy** and target audience
tickets.notes: Who is this for, what do they want to feel, and which games are they playing now.

tickets.title: Define **win and lose** conditions at wave, level and run scale
Set the target **session length** and run length
tickets.notes: Closely tied to the pacing complaint. Pick numbers (minutes per level, levels per act, acts per run) and design backwards from them.

tickets.title: Consolidate `docs/` into one **GDD index**: what is current, what is superseded
tickets.notes: The game repo's docs/ already holds ECONOMY_AND_UI_SPEC, SCALING_AND_SYNERGY, BETWEEN_WAVES_DESIGN, HERO_ECONOMY_DESIGN_IDEAS and more. Some predate the RTS pivot. One index that says which are live stops us designing from stale pages.
